items.title: George Shearing interviewed by Joe Williams, New York City, New York, March 8, 1996

ctx.x: Oh he was very authentic. Dizzy. Well Chano Pozo, you know, and that’s where McKibbon learned all that stuff, from Chano Pozo. And then of course McKibbon came with me, and Tjader, Cal Tjader. And then Armando.

Oh, boy. And I remember one day Max said to me, “I want to play something, you tell me where one is.” [scats]. I said, “How’s that again?” [scats]. He says, “One” [scats] — “one” [scats]. © Fillius Jazz Archive -5-
